title: Pin phase-aware declared completion through the real ordinary and native producers
outcome: Producer-level deterministic interposition tests fail if either original declared END producer stops selecting the settlement phase.
acceptance: Exercise the real ordinary and native declared completion producers with a deterministic pause after END and before verdict application; a wait refreshed there remains pending.
The tests observe the selected row's pending phase and later artifact verdict, with no real sleeps and without mirroring Markdown or fabricated credit.
